note: Cognis v0.2 ghost-text stems. Still on-device templates (no model, no network) offered during a cognitive pause to help the user address a detected gap — a small pretrained stem model is a future upgrade behind the same engine surface. v0.2 widens each gap type from 2 to several rotating variants (no-immediate-repeat) — always a short static opener the user continues, never text derived from what the user typed: a stem is published on ghosttext.generated, so anything folded into it would travel over the EventBus, which ADR-019 reserves for hashes/derived signals only, never raw prompt text.
